newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Nov 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Nov 11.

text.p: The Washington Post carries the following stories on its front page:

WASHINGTON - President Clinton declared that if he "could do one thing" in his second term it would be to balance the federal budget, an accomplishment that has eluded every chief executive for almost three decades.

WASHINGTON - Army leaders chose to go public last week with news of the expanding investigation into sexual misconduct at a training facility out of concern word of the inquiry would leak and the Army might face accusations of a coverup.
ABERDEEN PROVING GROUND, Maryland - Sex charges strike a nerve in the service as scores of new complaints flood the Army's hot line.

ISLAMABAD, Pakistan - The caretaker government of Pakistan said it is preparing criminal charges against former Prime Minister Benazir Bhutto and her husband in connection with the avalanche of corruption allegations that were part of the political crisis leading to her ouster.

CLARKSBURG, West Virginia - For 16 months the FBI used informants, secret recordings, surveillance cameras and more than 100 law enforcement officers to investigate whether a former evangelical missionary led a militia group planning to blow up a big FBI computer center near here.
WASHINGTON - Washington Redskins football team loses to Arizona after a four-hour, four-minute marathon.
